transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As you all know, we have $9,000,000 available in the group cash pool for subsidiary allocations beginning October 1, 2026. We have three funding requests: North needs $4,000,000 for payroll, East needs $3,000,000 for inventory purchases, and West needs $2,000,000 for debt service. The total requested is $9,000,000, which exactly matches what we have available. Before I finalize the allocation plan, I want to make sure we go through the treasury pre-release checklist — tax, accounts payable, and legal owners will need to review and initial each subsidiary funding plan before any funds are released. Do any of you have concerns or additional information I should consider before I make the allocation decision?
